entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: Today's producer prices are the test of whether the 0.4 percent CPI impulse and the ten-year at 5.1 keep the dollar bid.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: Euro-dollar at 1.1081 is already in a five-day decline, and the short pays if that dollar bid extends through the producer-price reaction.

entry_rationale: Sell 10 million euro-dollar. The euro is the cleaner incremental dollar than adding yen or chasing dollar-Canada.
entry_thesis: The dollar is the clean expression of the rates bid. The book is already long dollar-yen from 158.06 to 159.70. Euro, sterling, the Australian dollar and the kiwi have all fallen, while dollar-Canada and dollar-Swiss are already near one-year highs. Hold the yen long and sell 10 million euro-dollar as the incremental dollar, rather than adding more yen or chasing the extremes.

events.rationale: Sell 10 million euro-dollar. The euro is the cleaner incremental dollar than adding yen or chasing dollar-Canada.

invalidation: The long-dollar book fails if producer prices disappoint and the ten-year gives back the 12 basis point rise, or if euro, sterling, Australia and New Zealand stabilize together. The existing dollar-yen long is invalidated by a move back through 158.06.
